Healthy baseline boot ID was 82813604-4a59-46bc-b389-27614b13f0ff; reboot was acknowledged and observed; recovered boot ID was 17c788e3-3ed3-4186-8b45-1da6b903515a. Unbound, NetworkManager, configuration, listeners, external resolution, and caching all recovered.
